summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for grid execution and labor-productivity bottlenecks. The list is deliberately two-lane: Quanta Services is the obvious reference leader for utility construction scale; MYR Group, Preformed Line Products, and TIC Solutions are the underfollowed or shadow candidates tied to specialty electrical construction, installable transmission hardware, robotics-adjacent installation tooling, and testing/inspection/certification services. The strongest direct-service exposure is PWR and MYRG; the most node-specific second-order hypothesis is PLPC because external evidence links its transmission hardware and robotic-installation angle to lineworker productivity constraints. TIC is included as a hypothesis after its NV5 combination because it may contain public exposure to utility inspection/geospatial/engineering services, but customer and segment proof must be verified.
